profile: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL with pgvector. Built a RAG assistant over 800 support documents with LangChain and an evaluation harness. React and TypeScript frontend for internal dashboards. Three years of backend work.

hard_checks: output parses as a single JSON object with exactly the fields in output_format
no em dash or en dash characters anywhere in the output
mensagem_candidatura is null unless decisao is candidatar
scored_checks: alertas non-empty when expect.alertas_nonempty is true
every evidencias.trecho_perfil traceable to the profile (manual spot check)

grounding: justificativa and mensagem_candidatura contain no inflation term (production, scale, senior, expert, ingestion, ease, and similar) absent from the profile, and the message uses only numbers present in the profile. Cases may list allow_terms for words that legitimately appear in the job title
rubric.notes: Primary metric is decisao exact match. Score ranges were computed by hand from the 70/30 rule and are tolerant to +/- 3 points for rounding.
